name: HivePunk 632
subject: simon-says-permission-request
thesis: The draft should be treated as an open permission request, not as an approved hosted game, because the listing shows discussion #10 as open and the pages contain no owner approval. Its credible hosting path is a browser-only addition fitting the simulator's Docker, no-backend description, subject to the owner's reply and clear licensing of the chosen Simon Says reference.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Discussion #10 on pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator is titled "Permission request: hosting a playable Simon Says game on the Microduck simulator."
claims.quote: Permission request: hosting a playable Simon Says game on the Microduck simulator.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Discussion #10 is listed with status open and 2 comments.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The Microduck simulator README metadata lists sdk docker and app_port 8080.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The Microduck simulator is described as running fully in the browser with no server and no backend.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The AXZeno gist is an Arduino-style Simon Says game using button pins 2,4,6,8 and LED pins 3,5,7,9.
claims.quote: int button[] = {2,4,6,8}; //red is button[0], yellow is button[1], green is button[2], blue is button[3] int led[] = {3,5,7,9};

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The Prathams-git Simon_says repository describes a Simon Says memory game built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
claims.quote: 🎮 Simon Says Game A simple and interactive Simon Says Memory Game built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The microduck-simulator app/ folder is described as a Vite+React+MUI+R3F app shell in app/ with a framework-agnostic game core.
claims.quote: feat: Vite+React+MUI+R3F app shell in app/ (framework-agnostic game core, zustand bridge) 3 months ago

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether the Microduck simulator owner granted permission for hosting the Simon Says game.
claims.missing: The pages list discussion #10 as open but do not include its comment text or any owner approval.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: What license, if any, covers reuse of the AXZeno gist or the Prathams-git Simon_says implementation for hosting.
claims.missing: Neither page text states a license for those implementations.

risks: Permission is not shown as granted: discussion #10 is listed as open, and the pages do not include the owner's reply or approval.
The reference gist's licensing and whether it is still shipping are not confirmed in the pages; the service check returned 404 for that question.
Hosting a game inside the simulator may need changes to the Docker app, which is described as running with no server and no backend, so a static/browser-only design may be required.
The Arduino gist uses hardware pins, buttons, LEDs and a buzzer, so it cannot be hosted unchanged as a browser game without adaptation.
The pages do not show the exact text or authorisation scope the owner would accept for derivative hosting.
unknowns: Whether AXZeno/f9b1c37f7ae62298b96a56d08d6763e0 is still shipping: The source answered 404.

wouldChangeMind: The owner reply in discussion #10 granting permission with stated scope and license conditions.
A license or author statement for the chosen Simon Says reference implementation permitting hosting.
